title: On two forms in many variables of different degrees
summary: In this paper, we investigate integral solutions satisfying the system of two forms in many variables of different degrees. Let $d_1$ and $d_2$ be natural numbers with $d_2>d_1\geq 2$. Let $F_{i}(\boldsymbol{x}) \ (i=1,2)$ be forms in $n$ variables of degrees $d_i\ (i=1,2)$, respectively.
